service.controller: One bounded concurrency controller shared by every cell and prompt in this service grid
service.sampling: Explicit fixed decoding and reasoning settings per frozen OpenRouter trial profile; request audit verifies their application
service.error_policy: Transport failures excluded; bounded retries within logical trial; invalid answers never retried
service.raw_verifier: Frozen snapshot verify.py, run in a subprocess after source hash checks

interval.scope: Pointwise per cell, prompt and answer; proportion of accepted answers only

redactions: Working directories are replaced by hashes; a neutral root directory is disclosed as / when used.
Session and response IDs are hashed. Credentials, environment, CLI argv, binary paths and free-form error text are not exported.
Public rows are selected fields from verified native logs. Raw logs stay local; raw file hashes are commitments, not transcripts.
cost_basis: OpenRouter response usage.cost for the pinned route when exposed, including failed attempts with usage; not a verified bill. Field name pi_reported_cost is kept for compatibility.
model_identity: Requested model and effort come from the frozen schedule. Native reported model is retained and checked where exposed. Immutable backend snapshot is not independently established.
